products.title: Universal PTFE Dot Mouse Skates (40-Pack)
products.summary: Rounded 100% pure PTFE dot skates that fit any wireless or wired mouse. Smooths out mouse movement on cloth, glass, or hard pads.

Curved edges keep the skates from catching on cloth desk mats
0.8mm thickness with clean 3M adhesive backing that peels off without residue
Includes 2 alcohol cleaning wipes to prep the bottom of your mouse

products.title: Pre-Cut Universal Mouse Grip Tape Set
products.summary: Thin 0.5mm textured grip stickers for your mouse buttons, sides, and palm area. Gives you a steady grip when your hands get warm.
highlights: Pre-cut rectangles, hexes, and curved strips fit almost any mouse shape
Soft 0.5mm textured polyurethane absorbs sweat and stops finger slip
Uses genuine 3M adhesive that stays put and peels off cleanly later
Great for mice, keyboard spacebars, or controller triggers

products.title: Knurled Aluminum Rotary Encoder Knob
products.summary: Replacement machined aluminum volume knob with a textured grip. Fits standard D-shaft rotary encoders on Q-series keyboards and macro pads.
highlights: Machined from solid aluminum with knurled sides for easy one-finger turning
Slides right onto standard 6mm D-shaft rotary encoders—no tools required
Fits our Q14 Pro keyboard, Q0 Pro number pad, and most custom mechanical boards
Anodized matte finish won't peel or fade over time

specs.Compatibility: Keychron Q/V Series, Monolith Q14/Q0 & Standard EC11 Encoders

products.title: Gold-Plated Mechanical Switch Springs (110-Pack)

Medium 62g bottom-out weight gives a snappy key return without tiring your fingers
Gold-plated stainless steel resists corrosion and cuts down on spring ping
Works with Cherry MX, Gateron, Kailh, and other MX-style mechanical switches

products.summary: Complete set of smokey screw-in PCB stabilizers with gold-plated wires to stop rattle on your spacebar, Enter, Shift, and Backspace keys.
highlights: Screws directly into your keyboard PCB so stabilizers never pop loose when swapping keycaps
Includes four 2u stabilizers plus both 6.25u and 7u spacebar wires
Thick gold-plated steel wires stay straight and quiet down spacebar rattle
Comes with gold mounting screws and protective PCB washers

products.title: 2-in-1 Stainless Switch & Keycap Puller
products.summary: Dual-ended keyboard tool with wire loops on one side for pulling keycaps without scratching them, and tempered steel prongs on the other for removing switches.
highlights: Thin stainless wire loops slip cleanly around keycaps without scuffing the sides
Stiff steel switch puller on the opposite end pops hot-swap switches out easily
Textured center handle gives you a comfortable grip during full keyboard builds
One compact tool replaces separate plastic pullers
